title: Minuta 2026-10-27
summary: The minutes of the October meeting show a unanimous hold at 4.5%, but with a 25bp hike to 4.75% formally on the table: all Consejeros agreed both options were plausible, and some argued the hike 'had a solid base of support' because the oil shock is larger and more persistent, short-term inflation expectations have jumped and the peso has weakened, so a higher nominal path is needed to keep the real TPM consistent with the IPoM. The case for holding was tactical rather than dovish: one Consejero preferred to hike alongside forward guidance in the December IPoM, another saw medium-term risks pointing in opposite directions given weak demand, and all agreed the Bank must be clear about its heightened concern and readiness to act. Versus the September minutes, where holding was 'clearly dominant', activity weakness was the centre of gravity and the risk discussion flagged inflation undershooting the target, the Consejo has swung to an explicit tightening bias, with propagation and de-anchoring risk now the dominant concern. The minutes are also clearly more hawkish than the October statement, which only signalled upside risks and an open door to changes.

key_quotes.quote: En ese contexto, todos los Consejeros estuvieron de acuerdo en que era plausible evaluar tanto la opción de mantener la TPM en 4,5% como la de aumentarla en 25 puntos base (pb), hasta 4,75%.
key_quotes.context: A 25bp hike was one of the two options the whole Consejo considered plausible

key_quotes.quote: Algunos Consejeros destacaron que subir la TPM en 25pb en esta Reunión tenía una base sólida de apoyo.
key_quotes.context: Part of the Consejo made the affirmative case for hiking already in October

key_quotes.quote: Todos los Consejeros coincidieron en que el alza de las presiones de costos observada desde la Reunión anterior había elevado el riesgo de que el shock acumulado desde marzo terminara propagándose hacia otros precios con mayor fuerza y adquiriera una persistencia mayor que la habitual.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous view that propagation/persistence risk from the cost shock has risen

key_quotes.quote: Por una parte, para efectos de la comunicación, era preferible aumentar la TPM con una guía de cuál sería su trayectoria futura, lo que podía hacerse con mayor claridad junto con la publicación del próximo IPoM.
key_quotes.context: The argument for holding was about timing the hike with December IPoM guidance
